apps.localizedDescription: 基于 MoviePilot 的 Flutter 跨端客户端，对接 MoviePilot v2 API，在手机上完成订阅、搜索、下载、整理与系统运维等常用操作。

versions.localizedDescription:
MoviePilot Release

- Version: 1.2.7
- Build Date: 2026-10-30
- Android: Signed universal APK
- Android: Signed arm64-v8a APK
- iOS: Unsigned IPA

iOS 安装说明：
- IPA 为未签名包
- 请使用自己的 Apple Developer 账号通过 AltStore、Sideloadly 或 Xcode 进行签名安装


## What's Changed
* fix(dashboard): 收敛最新入库海报卡片阴影避免粘连 by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/119
* feat: 仪表板捷径/快捷操作/近期整理等看板组件与弹层控制器生命周期修复 by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/120
* fix(search): 搜索页按账号权限收敛入口与建议列表（#74） by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/121
* feat: 对齐 MoviePilot v3 契约（MFA 登录/微信机器人/订阅活动日志）并优化 401/403 提示（#122 #123 #124 #126） by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/125
* fix(image): 修复图片加载缓慢与 Cookie 外泄（#128） by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/129
* feat(image): CachedImage 加载态改为微光占位并移除逐字节重建（#130） by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/131
* feat(ui): Dashboard 与 Recommend 补齐首屏骨架 by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/134
* fix(recommend): 首个推荐请求等待 Cookie 就绪再发出 by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/137
* fix(music): 音乐搜索补齐艺人检索并始终代理境外音乐封面 by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/138
* feat(update): 自更新支持选择与自定义加速源 by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/140
* feat(music): 对齐 v3 单曲详情页，搜索与曲目列表可打开单曲 by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/132
* fix(subscribe): 补齐更多页订阅卡封面并修复弹层预热 401 by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/142
* chore(release): dev → master (2026-10-23) by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/144
* fix(dynamic-form): APPLitePush 测试路径跟随插件标识，避免 404 by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/148
* 播放器:修复杜比 P5 偏绿、进出播放页旋转叠影、弹幕开关不持久化 by @anlan-home in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/150
* 修复媒体库合集(BoxSet)打开方式:不再进入 MP 详情页,成员列表透传宿主钩子 by @anlan-home in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/152
* release: v1.2.7 by @singleton-altman in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/155


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/compare/release-v1.2.6-2026-10-23...release-v1.2.7-2026-10-30
